title: [review] lora_ipv6_mesh-mkk4: fuzz target uses old from_bytes API
description: `rust/lichen-schc/fuzz/fuzz_targets/fuzz_fragment.rs:8` — `Fragment::from_bytes(data, &mut tile)` uses the old two-argument API (with a tile buffer output parameter). The new `from_bytes()` signature takes only `&[u8]` and returns a `Fragment` borrow. The fuzz target will not compile.
